idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In 2023-24 income per person is level (Chhattisgarh ₹1,48,922, West Bengal ₹1,49,515), yet Chhattisgarh has 1,321.1 kWh of electricity available per person against 681.1 (1.94 times; 2.05, 1.94, 1.98 over the last three years; India 1,168.5).
Power available to the state, not what people use. Blank: Ladakh and Dadra, Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu (no row in the table). The table shows how much, not why.
source: Electricity: per capita availability of power, kilowatt-hours, 2023-24, Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 138 (34 states and UTs; per capita figures use population projections of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare). Income: per-capita net state domestic product, current prices, 2023-24, same Handbook, Table 19 (33 states and UTs with data).
